Life RPG

Complete useful daily quests, earn XP, unlock combat skills, and work together to defeat the Chaos Dragon.

Best with a friend. Each player can use a separate device.
ADVENTURE PARTY

Ready Room

Rules
  1. Each player receives 12 daily quests: 4 Easy, 5 Medium, 3 Hard.
  2. Completing a quest grants XP and combat energy; quests do not damage the boss.
  3. Spend energy on unlocked skills to attack the Chaos Dragon. Unlocked skills appear below the battle buttons and have a Use button in the Skill Tree.
  4. Leveling follows a Minecraft-inspired cumulative XP curve, scaled 25% harder.
  5. Every level grants skill points; higher levels grant more.
  6. Choose a class in the lobby. Reach Level 5 to choose a subclass; class features change combat.
  7. The party wins when the boss reaches 0 HP.
